mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level (FEDFUNDS) directly reduces the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the cost of capital declines across the corporate sector.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns show no significant positive correlation with FEDFUNDS levels (Rank IC < 0.03) or t-test p-value > 0.05 when comparing low vs high FEDFUNDS quartiles.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0%, it signals a tight labor market that accelerates wage growth and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through stronger corporate earnings momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE < 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal fails to outperform baseline returns in 60%+ of triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2.0%) and accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS < 2.5%) create a stable environment for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced real interest rate volatility.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when both CPIAUCSL < 2.0% and FEDFUNDS < 2.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction term coefficient is insignificant (p > 0.05) in regression analysis.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production growth (INDPRO > 0.5% MoM) indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings expansion, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days during active supply-side recovery phases.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive during INDPRO > 0.5% MoM periods (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) directly reflect strong consumer demand for residential construction, boosting related sector earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through immediate market sentiment effects.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns show no significant positive correlation with HOUST levels (Rank IC < 0.03) or t-test p-value > 0.05 when comparing high vs low HOUST months.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales growth (RSAFS) exceeds 0.5% month-over-month, it signals robust consumer spending that accelerates corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through earnings momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when RSAFS > 0.5% MoM (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal fails to generate positive returns in 65%+ of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of robust job growth (PAYEMS > 200,000 new jobs/month), rising employment directly supports consumer spending and corporate profit margins, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through sustained economic expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive during PAYEMS > 200,000 months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Combined strong job growth (PAYEMS > 200,000) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) signal a self-reinforcing labor market cycle that accelerates wage growth and consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through multiplicative economic momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when both PAYEMS > 200000 and UNRATE < 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction effect is insignificant (p > 0.05) in regression analysis.
